newsitem.title: CHINA: Swiss Reinsurance opens China office.
newsitem.headline: Swiss Reinsurance opens China office.

text.p: Swiss Reinsurance Co has opened its first representative office in China, the Xinhua news agency said in an overnight report.
The office opened on Wednesday in Beijing and was the company's eighth in Asia, Xinhua said.
The Swiss insurance giant has had business links with China since the early 1970s, especially in marine reinsurance, Xinhua quoted the company's chief executive officer Lukas Muehlemann as saying.
Swiss Reinsurance could help China's insurance sector develop its first reinsurance support and risk-taking funds, Xinhua quoted Muehlemann as saying.
In July, China set up its first reinsurance company, the People's Reinsurance Company of China Ltd.

Many foreign insurance firms, keen to tap into China's potentially huge market for insurance, have set up representative offices in China but only two foreign insurers, American International Assurance Co Ltd and Tokio Marine & Fire Insurance Co Ltd, have been allowed to issue policies in China.
